notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics vendor exploring Redwood Hosted API for fast prototyping, plan to graduate to Dedicated for production. POC metrics satisfactory but procurement/legal now gating.

Deal history (shorthand):
- 2024-09-17: Intro call (AE Alexandra, SE Diego) — agreed test dataset, initial latency SLO ask: p95 < 120ms for chat responses.
- 2024-10-05: Hosted API demo + Fireflies (ff_2024-10-05_G2H1x2) — product team liked streaming & function-calling.
- 2024-10-22: 2-week Hosted POC started (chat + embeddings). Stressed 200 qps synthetic load for reranking pipeline.
- 2024-11-08: POC results — latency p95 110ms on hosted; embedding throughput ok; cost baseline estimated ~30k/mo on hosted for current traffic.
- 2024-11-15: Dedicated demo (capacity models, autoscale, VPC peering) — engineering requests: KMS integration, 1y audit log retention, private subnet support.

Legal & procurement specifics:
- Willowmere procurement submitted MSA/DPA with standard redlines. Key asks: stronger indemnity language, explicit SLA (target 99.95%), credits table, data residency clause requiring NA-only hosting for customer data retention, and DPA retention limits.
- Security team requires SOC2 Type II evidence and confirmation of encryption-at-rest with customer-managed KMS for Dedicated.
- They flagged audit_logging and retention controls; need explicit SLAs on log availability and export.
- IP and derivative-use language: customer wants carveouts for embeddings derived from their proprietary corpora.

Price sensitivity & commercial notes:
- Mid-market procurement constrained to FYQ4 approvals. Estimated ARR target 50k-150k depending on final discounts for 12m commit.
- Interested in committed Dedicated pricing + predictable unit economics. Open to limited trial discount if contract signed within month.

Quotes & direct feedback: "Hosted POC performance looks promising but we need contractual assurances on data residency and SLA before we move traffic to Dedicated." — Head of Product.

POC artifacts: hosted POC logs and latency dashboards linked in Drive. SE Diego has JIRA ticketed integration notes (JIRA-4217).

Next steps (detailed):
- Redwood legal to propose MSA redline counter (target: 2024-11-30).
- Security doc handoff: provide SOC2 report + KMS integration guide (due 2024-11-27).
- Commercial: issue draft SOW for Dedicated capacity (Alexandra to send 2024-11-29).
- Procurement review meeting scheduled week of 2024-12-02.

Short blockers: legal smoke on indemnity & DPA, procurement calendar, one encryption gap to validate.
